name: record-field
body: A list's item descriptor declares an inline nested record: `item: {type: record, fields: [...]}`. A record's `fields:` uses the same descriptors as a template's top-level fields (name, type, rules and description), so a record's field may be a list whose item is a record — records nest through a list's item descriptor — and any field may carry `nullable` (nullable-fields). Its value is a YAML mapping validated recursively against its `fields:`, with a violation reported by full path (e.g. `items › [2] › value: …`). In layouts a record's `text` fields are pre-rendered and its other fields arrive typed, exactly like top-level fields.
